message.content:
For a fair (unbiased) coin there are only two possible outcomes on each flip—heads or tails—and both are assumed equally likely.  
Hence  

\[
P(\text{Head})=\frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total outcomes}}
               =\frac{1}{2}=0.5 \quad (\text{or } 50\%)
\]

So you have a one‑in‑two chance of landing on heads.
